window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; two verifiable new stories surfaced.

stories.headline: Five-week ATF and DEA push in the Portland area nets 17 arrests and 97 firearms
stories.summary: The US Attorney's Office for Oregon announced the results on 26 October. Agents recovered methamphetamine, cocaine, crack cocaine and fentanyl alongside the guns; the announcement…

stories.headline: Colombian Navy intercepts a fishing-style boat with 1.25 tonnes of cocaine packed in an ice chest off Chocó
stories.summary: The Navy reported the stop on 26 October in the Pacific west of Chocó, with the rectangular packages hidden among fish cargo and the vessel towed to Buenaventura.
